items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: There was one guy, John Lollop. Everything, you know.

ctx.x: Well, did they roll pills around there? I guess so, they did everything.
There was one guy, John Lollop. Everything, you know.
John, I think it was John Lollop told me about one guy that rolled so many pills that turned him white. Yeah, well. Yeah, well.
